component.name: AniCraft
component.summary: Draw and animate 2D vector art on a timeline

description.p: This community package is maintained independently of the AniCraft project and uses its official Linux release.

AniCraft is an open-source, native 2D animation studio. Draw with vector tools, animate on a layered timeline with keyframes, classic, shape and motion tweens, and export frames, GIFs, sprite sheets, SVG, Lottie and video.

ul.li: Pen, pencil, shapes, paint bucket, text, width and subselection tools for editable vector art
Timeline with layers, folders, masks, onion skin, easing and a motion editor
Symbols, a library and nested timelines
Opens FLA and XFL documents as untitled copies
Every action is a command, scriptable from a CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server

description.p: FlatPark supplies updates. The built-in update helper does not have network or host access in this package. The command-line tool can access Documents, Pictures and Videos; to use paths elsewhere in your home directory, run flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.anicraft. Undo this with flatpak override --user --nofilesystem=home ai.storyteller.anicraft.
